marigold.name: Marigold General Store
marigold.greeting: Welcome in! Potions on the left, coins on the right. Mind the cat.

fizzwell.name: Grotto Supply Co.
fizzwell.greeting: Hard hats are mandatory down here. Full Remedies are recommended.

food.name: Pretzel Pavilion
food.greeting: Fresh pretzels, warm from the oven. Grab a Trail Mix for the road.

lanternhall.name: Concierge Desk
lanternhall.greeting: Welcome to Lanternhall City. How can I help you today?

thrift.name: Second Chance Threads
thrift.greeting: Everything here is pre-loved and fairly priced. Try anything on, dear.
thanks: It suits you better than its last owner.
Come back when the racks change.

sports.name: Personal Best Sports
sports.greeting: Gear that keeps up with you. Step on in and warm up!
thanks: Now go set a personal best!
That fit is fast just standing still.

designer.name: Maison Margin
designer.greeting: Welcome to Maison Margin. Everything here is exclusive. Especially the prices.
thanks: Exquisite. The receipt alone is a collector’s item.
You wear it like old money.

capital.name: Capital Mart
capital.greeting: Welcome to Capital Mart! Open all hours, every hour, including the extra ones.

outlet.name: Capital Outlet
outlet.greeting: Last season from every boutique in the inner world, all under one roof. Same prices, more mirrors.
thanks: A city look if I ever saw one.
Walk tall, the pigeons are watching.
Come back when the window display changes.

palmhaven.name: Haven Duty-Free
palmhaven.greeting: Welcome to Haven Duty-Free! Everything is tax-free, especially the things that are not.

frostcrown.name: Summit Supply
frostcrown.greeting: Altitude makes everything more expensive. Except me. I’m fair.

twinpetal.name: Twinpetal Market
twinpetal.greeting: Everything grows back twice as fast here. The prices too.

goldvine.name: Bullion Exchange
goldvine.greeting: Gold, silver and everything priced in both. Mostly gold.

capshade.name: Cap Market
capshade.greeting: Prices go up and down with the spores. Today they are up. They are always up today.

glimmershaft.name: Assay Office
glimmershaft.greeting: Everything weighed, everything valued. Mostly by me.

kelpport.name: The Chandlery
kelpport.greeting: Rope, rations and risk management. The rope is the best value.

nimbus.name: Night Market
nimbus.greeting: Open all night, all day. It’s always night on this side of the tower.

pearlantis.name: The Pearl Exchange
pearlantis.greeting: Everything here was paid for in pearls. Some of it twice.
